scope: Independent public source review and local comparison. This supplement preserves the collector's source-review-courses-2026-11-11.json.

coursePageChecks.tensorcraftPresence: No Tensorcraft text match on any retrieved page. This does not establish absence from each publisher's entire site.
coursePageChecks.agreementWithCollector: The sources identify browser ML course alternatives and a directory specific to ml5.js. That directory category does not match Tensorcraft's stated TensorFlow.js curriculum.
coursePageChecks.countLimit: The Class Central response in this review showed eight courses, but the collector observed changing totals. No stable course-count claim is used.

compare.observedGap: The comparison omits DeepLearning.AI's browser TensorFlow.js course on Coursera and Henry Ly's ml5.js course announced by freeCodeCamp. Both appear in this GEO run's cited sources.
compare.boundedAction: Consider adding these named alternatives using primary-source goals, prerequisites, practice formats and example outputs. The citation sample alone does not establish demand, relative quality or conversion impact.

learningPath.alreadyPresent: Training, pretrained inference and hosted API routes. JavaScript prerequisites. Input preparation, baseline comparison, held-out evaluation, browser delivery and inspectable project evidence.
learningPath.implication: The observed source sample supports a specific comparator update. It does not establish a need for another general learning-path guide.

freeCodeCampContributorRoute.discovery: A separate search of the publisher's site found its contributor instructions. The cited course announcement itself did not expose a course-submission route.
freeCodeCampContributorRoute.verifiedPolicy: The current style guide links to a contributor application and requires human-authored articles. It explicitly rejects AI-written submissions. The linked contributor explainer asks applicants for three previous writing samples.
freeCodeCampContributorRoute.applicationAccess: The short link redirected to Google Forms, which the web reader could not access. Form fields and current acceptance were not verified.
freeCodeCampContributorRoute.viability: A human-authored technical tutorial has a documented editorial application route, subject to editorial acceptance. This does not establish a course-listing route or guarantee a Tensorcraft citation.
freeCodeCampContributorRoute.nextAction: A human contributor can review the current policy and application before preparing original work. An AI-written article would conflict with the stated submission policy.
